plain_statement.en: Every n ≥ 1,000,000 satisfies the strict disjointness criterion for the catalogue cutoff Q = ⌊log₂(n+2)⌋².
plain_statement.zh: 对于目录中的截断 Q = ⌊log₂(n+2)⌋²，每个 n ≥ 1,000,000 都满足弧不相交所需的严格不等式。

brief.en: For k ≥ 19, prove 2k⁴ + 3 ≤ 2ᵏ by induction. At k = ⌊log₂(n+2)⌋, the extra three units give the strict bound 2k⁴ < n.
brief.zh: 用归纳法证明 k ≥ 19 时有 2k⁴ + 3 ≤ 2ᵏ。取 k = ⌊log₂(n+2)⌋，预留的 3 保证严格不等式 2k⁴ < n。
